reuse.why: All month-wide actions, including the new one, take their categories from one new getMonthWideActionCategories and the #fixed check reuses the existing extractTagsFromText; the new action re-states the income-outside-tracking check and sign flip inline instead of sharing them.

duplication.why: Four copies of the visible-categories SQL and the hidden checks in copyPreviousMonth collapse into one function; only the per-action income check and expense sign flip remain repeated, now once more in setLastMonthSpending.

placement.why: The selection lives in budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use it, and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings with mutator(undoable(...)).

scope.why: Each edit serves one of the four steps; the hidden columns dropped from getBudgetData are the ones the shared selection now owns.

maintainability.why: Exclusion rules (hidden, templates, #fixed, flag) are changed in one documented function with a shared MonthWideActionArgs type; the income rule staying in each action is the remaining spot a maintainer must touch several times.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action, including copyPreviousMonth via an id set, goes through getMonthWideActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The category selection copies are removed into getMonthWideActionCategories rather than reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideActionCategories gains the requested includeHiddenCategories flag in step 4 (folded into its SQL); later rules (#fixed, templates) are added inside it as general exclusions and no action selects categories on its own.
